name: Dental
extra_prompt: You are booking for a dental practice. Ask about the concern, pain level, last visit, and health fund. Ask whether it is an emergency or routine. Do not give clinical advice in the booking flow. Quote prices only from the reference answers, and say the final price is confirmed after examination. Do not promise treatment outcomes or rebate amounts.

kb.a: {price_note} Check-up and clean pricing is confirmed before your appointment. Ask us about any extra x-rays before the visit.
Yes, we keep slots for emergencies. Call as early as possible, and we will triage your concern and book the earliest slot.

kb.q: Can I claim on private health?
kb.a: Whether we offer on-the-spot claiming is [HICAPS available: yes or no]. Bring your health fund details to your visit so we can check your cover.
{payment_note} Ask us about the options before any treatment starts.
Yes, we see children. Ask us about the Child Dental Benefits Schedule (CDBS) and whether your child is eligible.
Yes, we offer in-chair and take-home whitening. The best option depends on your teeth, so we check at your appointment.
Yes, we place single and multiple implants. Treatment starts with an examination, and we give you an estimate after your assessment.

kb.q: Do you do braces and clear aligners?
kb.a: Yes, we offer orthodontic treatment, including braces and clear aligners. Your options are confirmed at an assessment.
Yes, we do root canal treatment. Costs start from the price in our list, and the final cost is confirmed after examination.
Yes, including simple and wisdom tooth extractions. We confirm the plan after we examine the tooth.
Yes, including veneers and smile design. We discuss your goals at a consultation before you commit to treatment.
We can refer you for sedation or general anaesthetic for complex cases. Ask us which referral options apply to you.

kb.q: What if I have a toothache?
kb.a: Call us straight away, and we will triage your concern and book the earliest slot. If the pain is severe or you have swelling, say so when you call.
Most people visit every 6–12 months. Your dentist may recommend a different schedule.
Cancelling with less than {cancellation_notice} may incur a fee. Call as early as you can so the time can go to someone else.
Our dentists are registered with [registration body, e.g. AHPRA] under [your practice registration details]. Ask us for details before your visit.

kb.q: What should I bring to my appointment?
kb.a: Bring your health fund card, any referral, and a list of the medicines you take. Arrive a few minutes early to complete any forms.

templates.booking_confirmation: Hi {customer}, your {job} with {business} is booked for {date}.
templates.reminder: Reminder: your {job} at {business} is on {date}. Please bring your card and any referral.
templates.quote_intro: Here is your estimate. Your practitioner will confirm the plan at your appointment.
templates.invoice_note: Thank you. Health fund claims are handled by the practice where applicable.

required_information.label: Referral or Medicare details (only if the practice needs them)
Clinical details stay in the clinical record, not in booking notes

compliance.guidance: Health practitioners usually need registration (for example with AHPRA where it applies) and current professional indemnity insurance. Keep clinical details in the clinical record, not in general booking fields. Follow your state health privacy rules.
items: Clinical notes kept only in the clinical record
